research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01. Frozen occupation list empty; researched primary speech, party biography, parliamentary hearings, historical ministerial attendance, employer governance, UK company/chamber records and reliable contemporary reporting. No frozen roster refresh.

All employment hours remain unknown. Senior titles and roughly 20 years of broad experience in a governance biography are not full-time evidence. No date points manufactured from career length, ages, observation dates or ministerial terms.

Follow up Health Department graduate personnel/annual-report evidence, complete UK contracts and dates, Pharmacy Guild historical annual reports, names of two health ministers, Colbeck transitions, Barnett term, Premier resignation and campaign leave. Resolve overlap and breaks before calculation.

Family business identity and distinct other small businesses remain gaps; childhood farm upbringing is not paid agricultural employment evidence. Seek legitimate business biographies or declared operational interests, not family addresses or irrelevant personal data.

Reviewed public LinkedIn index matching cjagatenby but no usable historical dates/hours. Excluded unrelated UK mariner, medical researcher and deceased namesakes. Indexed 2010 Policy Exchange acknowledgement is only an association anchor, not employment boundary.

Source gaps: Harvest board PDF 404 (indexed text retained); NACA November 2014 minutes inaccessible; English Chartwell page fetch error, Spanish first-party page accessible; Golden Plains agenda and News.com.au full page Internal Error, indexed extracts used explicitly. Mandarin public career paragraphs accessible, subscriber-only remainder not accessed.

Next source-specific follow-up should identify family business and graduate employment, then historical employer/ministerial records; broad repeated searches yielded many namesakes. State presidency secondary 2023 endpoint unconfirmed; avoid repeated exhausted queries. All totals remain unknown, not zero.
